messages:
Priya Nair (Sales): Hey finance + legal — Cumulus Health is asking for a 3-month pilot with a steep discount. They want ~60% off for replatforming (est 2M tokens/mo). Need to close this week. Details: https://docs.google.com/...
Sam Cole (Finance): Need ARR / expansion assumptions. 60% seems high for a paid pilot. Can we propose 40% with a minimum commitment?
Diego Park (RevOps): We usually cap pilots. Recommendation: 3 months, 50% off, $30k minimum, usage cap 4M tokens total. Billing in arrears, SOW required. @Priya can you confirm customer ok with that?
Priya Nair (Sales): They said they're open to a paid pilot and can commit $30k if we fast-track. They want a signed MSA addendum. Trying to get signature today.
Ava Li (Legal): We can do a short addendum. Need explicit pilot credit clause + audit & DPT. Draft suggestion: ```PilotCredits: Customer receives a one-time credit of $30,000 applied to invoices during the Pilot Term (90 days). Credits expire and are non-refundable. Customer shall provide usage reports weekly and permit Redwood a reasonable audit of usage.```
Sam Cole (Finance): Fine from finance if we: 1) cap usage to avoid runaway charges, 2) mark revenue recognition rules (no revenue until cash), 3) discount applied as one-time credit. Approve up to 50% off capped at $30k if legal ok.
deal-bot: Automated check — requested discount (50%) exceeds SDR-approved 35%. Requires Finance + Legal sign-off. Logged as deal-1723456789.
Priya Nair (Sales): Thanks — I will push the MSA addendum and ask for signatures now. Will post signed doc here once done. :thumbsup:
Diego Park (RevOps): I'll create billing line item: "Pilot - Cumulus (Q2)" capped at $30,000, non-recurring. Will mark as credit allocation in billing system. ETA ~2 hours.
Ava Li (Legal): I approve the addendum language with the audit + DPT addition. Legal signs off.
Sam Cole (Finance): Finance final approval: 50% pilot credit up to $30k, one-time, cash-collected only, audit clause included. Approval record: Sam Cole (Finance) 1723456901"
